projectDescription: A cinematic, dark-themed personal portfolio built with Next.js 16 featuring AI-powered blog assistance, WebGL shader effects, GSAP animations, and a Supabase-backed blog system.
keyFeatures: Cinematic HLS video hero with GSAP-powered reveal animations
Supabase-backed dynamic blog with AI reading assistant (OpenRouter)
Particle-burst like system with Supabase persistence
Interactive skill radar with category-based visualization
Scroll-driven sticky timeline with GSAP animations
Contact system with Nodemailer SMTP, honeypot protection, and Hunter.io email verification
JSON-LD structured data, Open Graph, sitemap, and SEO optimization
Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights integration
publicApiSurface: GET /api/blogs — Fetch all blog posts from Supabase
GET /api/blogs/:id — Fetch single blog post by ID
POST /api/blogs/:id/ai-summary — Generate AI summary via OpenRouter
POST /api/blogs/:id/ai-chat — AI chat interaction for blog post
POST /api/contact — Submit contact form with email delivery and Supabase logging
lib/contact.ts: parseContactSubmission(), validateContactSubmission(), assertWithinRateLimit(), verifyEmailDeliverability(), insertContactRecord(), sendOwnerNotification(), sendAutoReply()
lib/blog-ai.ts: buildBlogContentSignature(), getDefaultBlogPromptSuggestions(), normalizePromptSuggestions(), stripBlogContentForAi(), extractJsonObject()
supabase/setup.sql: blogs table, blog_likes table, get_blog_likes_count(), has_session_liked()
